_contract: Turkish language pack. Loaded in addition to patterns.json when present.
Same contract: patterns match the FOLDED message (lowercased, reduced to ASCII), so they
are written without Turkish letters — write 'kullanici', never 'kullanici' with dotless i,
Useful when commit messages are occasionally written in Turkish out of habit even though
Direction matters: a forbidden reference has the USER as the speaker. The dative form
('kullaniciya soyledikleri' = what the app tells the user) is UI copy, not a reference,
and is excluded. 'duzeltme:' is not a narrative frame here: in Turkish the word means
both 'correction' and 'fix', and its technical sense is a legitimate body label.
